newsitem.title: USA: Ryland cites improved Q3 homebuilding.
newsitem.headline: Ryland cites improved Q3 homebuilding.

text.p: Ryland Group Inc on Thursday said a gain in its third quarter earnings was primarily due to higher homebuilding profits.
It reported consolidated net earnings for the third quarter of $4.5 million, or $0.25 per share, compared with $700,000, or $0.01 per share, for the third quarter of 1995.

Ryland's homebuilding segment reported pretax earnings of $5.3 million for the third quarter, versus $300,000 for the same period last year. The $5.0 million increase was attributable to improved gross profit margins as well as lower selling, general and administrative expenses, the company said.
